simple.summary: חָמִיץ (châmîyts) means seasoned , i.e. salt provender First listed occurrence: Isa 30 24.

definitions.full: H2548. chamits חָמִיץ adjective seasoned (namely with salt, or a salt herb — Arabic , Punic Ἀμουτ [ = ֗֗֗ חמוץ ] Dlau ZMG 1873, 522 ; see Thes — rendering it more tasty), of provender for cattle יאֹכֵ֑לוּ חָמִיץ בְּלִיל Isa 30:24 . חֻמְצָה see I. חמץ Infinitive
